com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.enums.OptimizationStrategy

Packages that use OptimizationStrategy
Package
Description
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.enums
Enumerations that parameterize the Metro Optimization Engine: OptimizationStrategy (scoring weight presets), WorkloadType (workload archetypes with built-in profiles), LatencySensitivity (default per-workload placement ceilings), SiteRole (site importance multipliers), RedundancyTier (metro-count floors and region-diversity selection), ComplianceZone (region-based data-sovereignty zones with deployment-level AND semantics), ScoreCategory (the five scoring dimensions), and RiskSeverity (risk-finding levels).
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model
Immutable value types for the Metro Optimization Engine — the request side (sites, provider requirements, workload specs, constraints, scoring weights) and the result side (ranked recommendations, scores, topology, latency matrix, risk assessment, cost estimates).
